welcome.body: This site scores countries, states and provinces against the Electric Protocol - the detailed question set behind the Charter. Pick a jurisdiction on the map to see how it does, what the evidence is, and which changes would raise its score the most.

scoreboard.heading: Policy Explorer
scoreboard.descriptionIntro: Pick a country on the map or in this list
scoreboard.descriptionRest: to see/edit its answers, the evidence behind each one, and the changes that would raise its score the most.
scoreboard.notEnoughDataToScore: Not enough data to score yet

countryPanel.overviewIntro: How {{name}} scores in each policy area, and how that compares to the rest of the field.
countryPanel.notApplicableHint: Not enough of this area's questions are answered yet to give it a score.

impactList.empty: Nothing to show yet - every answered question is already at full marks, or none have been answered. Use Policy Landscape to add some.

comparePicker.maxReached: Up to {{maxCount}} at once - remove one above to add another.

sectionRail.changeFirst: Change an answer or its evidence first

suggestionDialog.title: Submit revised evidence
suggestionDialog.noChanges: No changes recorded yet for {{name}} this session.
suggestionDialog.missingEvidence_one: {{count}} answer below has not had its evidence revised - add or edit at least one citation for each before this can be submitted.
suggestionDialog.missingEvidence_other: {{count}} answers below have not had their evidence revised - add or edit at least one citation for each before this can be submitted.
suggestionDialog.detailsIntro: Add your name and organisation so a reviewer knows who suggested this.
suggestionDialog.name: Name
suggestionDialog.done: Thanks - your suggested changes have been submitted for review.
suggestionDialog.sendFailed: Couldn't send it: {{message}}. Please try again.

questionCard.title: Title
questionCard.titlePlaceholder: Name of the law, decision or document

adminConsole.title: Admin console
adminConsole.description: Where the underlying question set lives: editing question text and impact, adding or removing topic groups and questions, adjusting each question's possible answers, and setting the questions-answered threshold used across the app.
adminConsole.confirmDeleteSection_one: Delete "{{title}}" and its {{count}} question? This also removes any answers already recorded against them.
adminConsole.confirmDeleteSection_other: Delete "{{title}}" and its {{count}} questions? This also removes any answers already recorded against them.
adminConsole.thresholdBody: How much of a jurisdiction's question weight needs an answer before it is coloured on the map and ranked on the scoreboard. Below this, a jurisdiction is shown grey and left out of the ranking.
adminConsole.dangerZoneBody: Discards every local edit - questions, weights, rubrics and answers - and reloads the shipped data. This cannot be undone.
adminConsole.confirmReset: Discard all local edits - questions, weights, rubrics and answers - and reload the shipped data?
adminConsole.rubricIntro: Answers a country can pick for this question, and the points each is worth toward its score (0 = counts for nothing, 4 = counts in full). The question's own Impactfullness above then scales how much that counts toward the overall total.
adminConsole.question: Question
adminConsole.questionTitleHelp: A few words shown on the question card; the full question opens on click.
adminConsole.revertQuestion: Revert this question to the shipped version
adminConsole.confirmDeleteQuestion: Delete this question? This also removes any answers already recorded against it.
adminConsole.reviewLoadFailed: Couldn't load everyone's suggestions: {{message}}. Reload to try again.

suggestionsReview.empty: No suggested changes yet. When someone uses "Submit revised evidence" on a country's page, it shows up here for review.

correctionDialog.title: Suggest a correction
correctionDialog.which: Which answer do you think is right?
correctionDialog.sourceHint: Link, or the name of a report or document - corrections need a source
correctionDialog.name: Your name
correctionDialog.done: Thanks - your correction has been submitted for review.

proposeDialog.title: Propose a new policy question
proposeDialog.intro: New questions are reviewed before they are added - once accepted, a question counts toward every country's score.
proposeDialog.question: Question
proposeDialog.sourceHint: Link, or the name of a report or document
proposeDialog.name: Your name
proposeDialog.done: Thanks - your question has been submitted for review.

report.ready: Your report is ready. It is an accessible PDF: preview it here, then download it.
report.failed: The report could not be made. Please try again.
report.openTab: Open the report in a new tab

editor.signInBody: The admin console changes the policy data everyone sees, so it's for named editors only. Sign in with the Google account you were given access with.
editor.notEditor: This account can't edit the policy data.
editor.databaseOffline: You're signed in, but this page couldn't reach the policy database, so editing is off. Reload to try again.

sync.error: Couldn't save: {{message}}. Reload to see what was saved.
